family_reset_reference.sections: 6.2.5: only I initialized at reset; V/H/N/Z/C unknown. 6.4.1: normal vector/queue reset. 6.4.5 (printed96): active-background reset precedes user-vector fetch; numerical PC not established here. 7.3.4.14/.19/.26: GO/READ_PC/WRITE_PC. Publisher PDF obtained from a mirror; exact bytes/hash retained locally. DIV (printed250): H:A/X, quotient A/remainder H; X and CCR V/H/I/N preserved, Z from quotient, C for zero/quotient>255; erroneous A/H indeterminate, hence Z unknown. Instruction details: MOV/BIT define V/N/Z; JSR/AIS preserve CCR; BEQ consumes Z. Instruction Set Details: CLR (printed241, including CLRH) and MOV (printed260) define V/N/Z and preserve C/H; AIS preserves all condition codes. ADC-path Instruction Set Details: BRSET7 copies tested bit to C; BHI/BLS consume C|Z, BNE consumes Z; PSHA/PSHX/PULA and JMP preserve CCR; LDA/LDX define V/N/Z, CMP/ASL/ROL define V/N/Z/C, ADD defines V/H/N/Z/C. SP1 effective address is SP+d8; ROL consumes incoming C. Table6-13 (printed130/131) supplies the complete ordinary opcode timing matrix; Table6-12/instruction details include CPHX direct5, SP1 CPHX6, MUL5, DIV6 and SP2/four-byte fetches. STOP/WAIT minimum costs do not qualify indefinite hold/wake behavior. Table6-10 and instruction details pin ADC-path unstretched byte/period counts, including BRSET7=5, JMP extended=4, SP1 ASL/ROL=6 and SP1 byte loads/arithmetic=4. Indexed STA (printed280): IX F7 wp2, IX1 E7 wpp3, IX2 D7 pwpp4; stores A, V=0,N=A7,Z=(A==0), preserving H/I/C. The native w-phase register reference and CPU/SPI launch/order contracts are not silicon timing qualification. CLR memory access details (printed241): DIR/IX1 rfwpp5; IX rfwp4; SP1 prfwpp6. The unused r value retains RAM bit knowledge; V0/N0/Z1, H/I/C preserved. Reference bus phases only. INC/DEC memory (printed249/252): DIR/IX1 rfwpp5; IX rfwp4; SP1 prfwpp6. V iff old7f/80 respectively, N=result7, Z=(result==0), H/I/C preserved; explicit r/f/w reference only.
